title: Canonical tensor coherence for a scalar assignment
statement: For every normalized scalar assignment S on the site, there is explicit SystemTensorCoherence S. Its ordinary unit and associators are the scalar adjoint-uniqueness comparisons normalized on pure tensors, and its derived unit and associators are the derived scalar adjoint-uniqueness comparisons, compatible with the universal cochain comparisons on flat-term independent K-flat complexes. All choices are the specified scalar models, and no flatness of coefficient maps is assumed.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, ordinary evaluation left extension and the subsequence generalization; Stacks 03DA, 03DB, 06YT and 07D9

proof.text: Apply the ordinary and derived scalar coherence constructions to identity coefficient maps and composable coefficient maps of B. Functoriality of B supplies the ring-map equalities. The scalar pure-tensor and universal cochain equations supply every normalization field. This is an explicit record construction, and the Nonempty result is its inhabitedness.
